sample_unit: clinician readers (3 otology professors, 5 senior residents, 5 junior residents) reading 100 images

links.outcome: Clinician diagnostic accuracy with versus without AI support across experience levels
links.effect: AI support raised primary accuracy from 78.7% to 89.7% (professors), 65.0% to 93.8% (senior residents), and 54.4% to 86.6% (junior residents), P<.001.
links.quote: AI support significantly enhanced diagnostic accuracy across all groups for primary classification, with improvements of 11.0% for otology professors, 28.8% for senior residents, and 32.2% for junior residents (P<.001).

screen.reason: The study conducts a retrospective reader study evaluating clinician diagnostic accuracy with and without AI assistance across different experience levels.
